QuestInfo.name: Back to Basics
QuestInfo.0: Lala wants to help Blake find his old passion.
QuestInfo.1: Lala wants you to meet with June, an old friend of Blake, to put him on the road to recovery. June is on the 7th/8th floor of the Shopping Center.
QuestInfo.2: You found June, Blake's old friend.

0.0: I didn't think becoming a celebrity would make Blake change this much...
0.1: He may still be popular, but it won't be long before his fans turn away. We need to return to his roots before that happens! Can you help him?

yes.0: June has been a friend of Blake for a long time. He even helped Blake with his debut. If Blake is going to get back to his old self, we're gonna need June's help. Look for him on the 7th/8th floor.

no.0: I am...disappointed in Blake, but I still don't want him to fail like this. Please reconsider.

1.0: What's up? Is there something I can help you with? ...Oh, it's about Blake, is it? Well...

npc.0: Ask June to help us with Blake. He might be the only one that can do this. He's on the 7th/8th floor.
